summary: The file deals with Email Popup Documents, including searching and deleting operations.
purpose: To handle email attachments and documents within the application.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the email popup document.

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: Name of the file associated with the email popup.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Path to the file in the system.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Indicates if the document is checked.

conditions: Deleting an email popup document also attempts to delete the directory where it's located.
system_behavior: Manages email popup documents including adding, finding, and deleting them.
